day.reading: each version halves a divergence count to a per-lineage requirement; the SNV-only 17.5e6 is a concession and still gives 91,600x
day.holds: every identity reproduces from Day's inputs: 30.2e6 x 1/2 = 15.1e6 (2019), 40e6/2 = 20e6 (2025), 35e6/2 = 17.5e6, 17.5e6/191 = 91,623 (91,600), 17.5e6/2,407 = 7,270 (7,271 at G_f 104.7). 17.5e6 brackets the measured fixed-event count (R4-GAP07b 16.4-18.1 M)

critic.reading: 17.5e6 is below the measured events per lineage; 17.9e6 achievable is an illustration
critic.holds: 17.5e6 is 83% of 21.05 M events per lineage (GAP-07b) and 72% of 24.14 M on the T2T count (GAP-07t); 17.9e6 reproduces only under linear supply scaling (M-006), which RE-09 itself disclaims

notes: Identity object; no verdict moves. Q12 calls the 40e6 'single-nucleotide variants'; the 35e6 + 5e6 split is CSAC's (SNVs plus indel events), and the 2025 halving reproduces only on that split. The paper's 2,407 achievable implies G_f 104.7, not the printed 105 (252,000 / 105 = 2,400); its 7,271 follows from that. The critic-side '83%' (claim A3b) is on the hg38/panTro6 count; on the T2T count it is 72%. Whether 17.5e6 is the right requirement (polymorphism, indels, structural events) is M-010 and M-011, not this object.
